decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: Count the integrated named Marmaray railway corridor once, retaining the original crossing and suburban-extension stages inside that identity. Do not count each station, duplicate the crossing as a separate project, add the proposed northern bypass, or confine the Gebze end to Istanbul municipality.

Count the Eurasia road tube crossing with its approaches as one named project. The two road decks and connecting works are components rather than independent projects, and the adjacent Marmaray railway remains a separate transport identity with different users, governance and evidence.

Count Istanbul's metropolitan municipal territory once and explain its services without turning districts or illustrative facilities into extra places. Keep national TOKİ housing, municipal service providers and the interprovincial Marmaray corridor distinct; no national or historical acquisition docket is reused.

review_checks: Identity screening found no Marmaray, Eurasia/Avrasya or Istanbul/İstanbul Atlas identity. Count two bounded transport projects and one metropolitan municipality; no historical acquisition docket is reused.

Eighteen official source records were inspected November 22: thirteen HTML bodies or scoped segments and five explicitly identified indexed records after direct timeouts. Five English and thirteen Turkish records retain author/AI interpretation and self-review, not independent review.

Three articles contain 547, 543 and 569 body words, eighteen sections and seventeen chronology events. Each has five source-bound sections and a labelled editorial evidence test. No new translated-reading identities are created.
AYGM's 2013 original crossing and 2019 suburban-completion dates are separate. The full Marmaray corridor extends to Gebze in Kocaeli; 1.7 million daily design capacity is not measured ridership.

The anniversary release's rounded 1.6 billion and the parliamentary account's 1.636 billion through September 30 are not a growth comparison. National/high-speed counts, conflicting daily-service totals and the premature first-ten-month figure are excluded. Parliamentary reporting is not independent verification.

The February 24 northern-railway source describes preliminary financing and tender preparation. Expected relief and airport links remain future context, not current service or another counted project.
The ministry's fare-entitlement FAQ does not establish station-level physical access. No individualized entitlement decision or card test occurred.

Eurasia's 14.6 km route includes a 5.4 km tunnel-and-connections portion and 9.2 km approaches. Two decks are not two projects; Marmaray is a separate railway. Chronology retains month/year precision.

Published investment splits and contract durations do not establish current profit or total fiscal exposure. Described emergency systems and rapid-response promises are not measured latency or safety certification.

The toll page includes motorcycles as a distinct class. Public payment-description review is not a transaction, verified live interface or permission for every vehicle.
